hub.title: Import and export
hub.intro: Bring your history from another app, or take your data with you whenever you want.
hub.csvNote: From your bank or any app
hub.missing: Don't see your app? Soon you'll be able to bring a CSV exported from it.
hub.downloadNote: JSON or CSV, from your spaces

status.DRAFT: Not confirmed: tap to review it

undo.title: Undo this import?
undo.body: We delete the movements it brought and archive the new accounts and categories nothing else uses. If you import it again, everything comes back.

moneyManager.title: From Money Manager
moneyManager.intro: Bring your accounts, categories and movements. You'll see a summary first; nothing changes until you confirm.
moneyManager.step1: In Money Manager, open More › Backup.
moneyManager.step2: Choose Export and save the .mmbak file on your phone or computer.
moneyManager.step3: Come back here and choose it.
moneyManager.privacy: We read the file to show you what it would bring, and we don't keep it. Nothing is recorded until you confirm.
moneyManager.readingNote: A large backup can take up to half a minute.

review.title: Review import
review.transferNote: Card payments and between your accounts
review.previously: You already imported this file on {date}. We only bring what's missing.
review.duplicates: {n, plural, one {{count} movement looks like one you already have. It stays out unless you include it.} other {{count} movements look like ones you already have. They stay out unless you include them.}}
review.duplicatesIncluded: {n, plural, one {{count} movement that looks like one you already have is imported.} other {{count} movements that look like ones you already have are imported.}}
review.alreadyImported: {n, plural, one {You already imported {count} movement; it isn't brought again.} other {You already imported {count} movements; they aren't brought again.}}
review.budgets: {n, plural, one {{count} budget isn't imported.} other {{count} budgets aren't imported.}}
review.zero: {n, plural, one {{count} zero movement stays out.} other {{count} zero movements stay out.}}
review.opening: {n, plural, one {{count} balance adjustment becomes its account's opening balance.} other {{count} balance adjustments become their account's opening balance.}}
review.dateZone: {n, plural, one {{count} movement keeps its date although its time falls on another day in this zone.} other {{count} movements keep their date although their time falls on another day in this zone.}}
review.rowErrors: {n, plural, one {{count} row couldn't be read and stays out.} other {{count} rows couldn't be read and stay out.}}

accounts.title: What is each account?
accounts.intro: {n, plural, one {Hearth suggested what your account is. Change it if it isn't right.} other {Hearth suggested what each of your {count} accounts is. Change it if it isn't right.}}

categories.title: Your categories
categories.intro: They come as you have them: each category is a group, with its subcategories and in your order.
categories.more: {n, plural, one {and {count} more group} other {and {count} more groups}}
categories.archiveUnused: Archive the Hearth ones you don't use
categories.archiveUnusedNote: {names} have no movements. You can restore them.
categories.archiveUnusedNone: You use all of Hearth's: there's nothing to archive.

done.title: Import done
done.headline: {n, plural, one {We imported {count} movement} other {We imported {count} movements}}
done.accounts: {n, plural, one {{count} new account} other {{count} new accounts}}
done.categories: {n, plural, one {{count} new category} other {{count} new categories}}
done.categoriesNote: In Other and in their groups
done.duplicates: {n, plural, one {{count} look-alike you left out} other {{count} look-alikes you left out}}
done.duplicatesNote: You can record them by hand if they were different
done.rowErrors: {n, plural, one {{count} movement wasn't imported} other {{count} movements weren't imported}}
done.rowErrorsNote: For example, from a closed period or with no exchange rate for its date
done.undoNote: Something went wrong? You can undo this import from Import and export: it deletes what it brought and leaves everything as it was.
done.accountsRestored: {n, plural, one {{count} account brought back} other {{count} accounts brought back}}
done.categoriesRestored: {n, plural, one {{count} category brought back} other {{count} categories brought back}}
done.restoredNote: An import you undid had archived them

export.title: Download my data
export.intro: Your data is yours. Download it to keep it or to take it to another app.
export.formatNote: JSON keeps everything as it is in Hearth. CSV opens in any spreadsheet.
export.includesBody: Accounts, categories, movements with who paid and how it was split, recurring movements and plans. The same as you see in Hearth.
export.never: Other members' personal accounts never leave: only their name on what they paid.
export.tooMany: You've downloaded your data several times. Wait a minute and try again.

portability.busy: Too many imports are running right now. Try again in a moment.

reason.currencyMismatch: Choose an account in the same currency it has in Money Manager.
reason.accountNotFound: That account is gone. Choose another or create a new one.
reason.categoryNotFound: That category is gone. Choose another or create a new one.
reason.groupNotFound: That group is gone. Choose another.
reason.unknownSource: The file doesn't have that. Upload the file again.
